title: Define a cohesive color palette
parentKind: story
parentId: ui-theme-polish

## Goal

Propose a small, accessible color palette (primary, accent, neutral, semantic)
and apply it to the todo app's styles. Document the tokens.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The palette MUST meet WCAG AA contrast for text on its background tokens.
- The tokens MUST be documented (name + hex + intended use).
